error.title: APPLICATION ERROR
error.subtitle: Something stopped working unexpectedly. Try reloading this screen or restarting the app.

setup.title: Let's set up your environment
setup.subtitle: No need to configure anything. We just need one tool to start managing your skills.
setup.toolDesc: Runs the skills CLI. We'll handle the install for you.
setup.prompt: Want us to set it up for you?
setup.manualCommand:
curl -fsSL https://get.volta.sh | bash
volta install node
setup.doneHint: Node.js is installed via Volta. We can now manage your skills.
setup.errorHint: The installer ran into an issue. You can try again.

home.title: Your skills at a glance
home.updatesError: Could not check for skill updates
home.noUpdates: All checkable skills are up to date

installed.title: Skills
installed.subtitle: {n} global skills managed by npx skills
installed.removeBody: Uninstall this skill from every agent on this machine:
installed.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, source, or agent…
installed.emptyHint: Install a skill with npx skills to see it here.
installed.removeAllBody: This uninstalls all {n} global skills from every one of your tools. There is no undo.

find.title: Find skills
find.subtitle: Search the skills registry
find.hint: Type at least 2 characters to search
find.emptyHint: Try a different query or clear the owner filter
find.hintExplore: Or browse the rankings if you don't know what to look for yet

custom.title: Install skills from anywhere
custom.subtitle: A GitHub repo or a SKILL.md you wrote yourself. Either way the skill ends up installed and ready for your agents.

remote.title: Install from a repository
remote.subtitle: Paste the link and we check which skills it ships before installing anything.
remote.label: GitHub URL or package
remote.hint: Takes github.com URLs, owner/repo handles, and owner/repo@skill references.
remote.errorInvalid: That is not a GitHub repository or a package reference.

local.title: Write a skill by hand
local.subtitle: Paste a SKILL.md or upload one from disk. Its frontmatter names the skill, and we install it like any other.
local.contentPlaceholder:
---
name: my-skill
description: what it does
---

# My skill

…
local.hint: We read the name and the description from the block between --- lines at the top.
local.blockMissing: The file has to start with a block between --- lines giving the skill a name and a description.
local.nameMissing: The block at the top is missing the skill's name.
local.descriptionMissing: The block at the top is missing the skill's description.
local.bothMissing: The block at the top is missing the skill's name and description.
local.nameInvalid: "{name}" won't work as a name: use letters, digits, dashes and dots, with no spaces.

explore.title: Explore skills
explore.subtitle: Browse the most popular and recent skills from the skills registry
explore.emptyHint: Try another board or search with Find
explore.packageHint: Will install globally in your device
